name: OpenAI's Structured Outputs instead of parsing its text
gain: OpenAI's words: the model "will always generate responses that adhere to your supplied JSON Schema" (vendor claim). No measured number here.
how: Use responses.parse with zodTextFormat in TypeScript or text_format in Python, or text.format with type json_schema and strict true. Keep the old parser as a fallback and test that the same keys come back.
replaces: JSON mode plus a parser, fence stripping, retry-on-parse loops.
trade_offs: The first request with any schema has extra latency.
A refusal or a max-tokens stop can leave the response without the schema, so both need handling.
A schema is limited to 5000 object properties and 10 levels of nesting.
needs: gpt-4o or newer. The page says gpt-4-turbo and earlier may use JSON mode instead.
usage_signal: Retries and output tokens on calls that are re-sent after a parse failure

gain_model.formula: parse_failure_rate * calls * cost_per_call = money lost to retries

inputs.name: parse_failure_rate
inputs.source: the product's usage data or the bill

inputs.name: calls
inputs.source: the product's usage data or the bill

inputs.name: cost_per_call
inputs.source: the product's usage data or the bill

test_recipe.what_to_compare: parse failures and schema errors, before and after

verify_rule: Parse-error logs and retried calls over 14 days after merge

change_recipe.how: Use responses.parse with zodTextFormat in TypeScript or text_format in Python, or text.format with type json_schema and strict true. Keep the old parser as a fallback and test that the same keys come back.
change_recipe.left_off: Nothing else changes; the new path sits behind a setting until a person turns it on

gain_independent: JSONSchemaBench (arXiv 2501.10868), table 4, on hard GitHub schemas: unconstrained output complied 13% of the time; OpenAI complied 100%, but only on the 9% of those schemas it accepted. The paper doesn't say strict mode, and says closed-source and open engines aren't directly comparable.
gain_vendor: OpenAI's words: the model "will always generate responses that adhere to your supplied JSON Schema" (vendor claim). No measured number here.
